title: TIE/IN interceptor (Star Wars, Return of the Jedi)
intro: The TIE interceptor is a fictional, faster version of the Empire's TIE fighter from Return of the Jedi. It has the same ball cockpit but pointed, dagger-shaped wings with four laser cannons at their tips. This guide takes the cockpit as the TIE fighter's; only the guns differ.

areas.name: Control yoke and throttle
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Control yoke
panels.text: The yoke with two hand grips in front of the pilot.
panels.context: The fire buttons sit under the thumbs.

controls.name: Fire buttons
controls.text: Buttons on the yoke grips under the thumbs fire the laser cannons at the tips of the dagger-shaped wings.
controls.context: The interceptor has four cannons instead of the TIE fighter's two, which makes it a stronger hunter of fighters.
